page.layout: One column of running text, with the page number and running head at the top. No marginal notes. Red stains and show-through at the left edge are not printed text.

main_text.p: aliquod, aut jus superius in eas sub velamine societatis velut princeps sibi vendicaverit, denique totam Bœotiam pro sua habuerit. Accedebat quod viribus suis freta injuriis quoque variis non raro proximos quosque horum sociorum vexaret. Quod cum ferre diutius Platæenses, quorum urbs LXX tantum stadiis a Thebanâ distabat, non possent, non vellent, aliquot annis ante pugnam Marathoniam, veteres amicos in Græcia tum potentissimos Lacedæmonios, quorum rex Cleomenes forte in ea loca venerat, opem rogarunt: sed ab his rejecti ob locorum nimis longa intervalla tempestivis auxiliis ferendis incommoda, vafro suasu eorundem, ut perhibet Herodotus, in clientelam Atheniensium propiorum se contulerunt. Unde bellum inter hos & Thebanos enatum, sed priusquam concurrerent acies ad pugnam jam paratæ a Corinthiis vicinis intercedentibus compositum. Dicta conditio, ut qui Bœotiorum fœdere Bœotico teneri nollent, id iis liberum esset: simulque termini definiti. Verum digressis Corinthiis Thebani pœnitentes conditionis Athenien-[?] armis adorti, sed ab his superati, & ultra priores terminos trans Asopum fluvium submoti. Hinc odium illo-rum

page.notes: The line break after "Athenien-" is partly hidden by the red edge; the completion "sium" is probable but not clearly visible. The final "rum" stands alone at the right of the last line and is the completion of "illo-". No catchword or signature is printed. Ink damage at the left edge affects the first letters of several lines.
